title: 第3章 三百年才长一片的宝叶你要拿来涮火锅第4章 极品聚气丹
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
“那是七…七霞琉璃盏！
三百年才长一片的宝叶！
是炼制元婴期丹药的主药之一！
有…有禁制守护的啊！
你怎么摘下来的？！
还要涮火锅？！
！”
云杳杳看着赵明瞬间惨白的脸色和颤抖的手指，无辜地眨眨眼，迅速把手里那半片叶子藏到身后，一脸“我什么都没干”
的表情：
“啊？禁制？没感觉到啊？它自己掉下来的，我看掉了怪可惜的……不能涮吗？那烤着吃呢？”
赵明指着她，手指抖啊抖，一口气差点没上来。
他预感到，青云宗内门，恐怕要迎来一位前所未有的……混世魔王了。
而走在前面的林风啸等人回头看到这一幕，再次陷入了深深的沉默与茫然。
这位引动万古异象、测出废灵根、对珍稀灵植第一想法是能不能涮火锅的小师妹……未来，这青云宗，怕是再也清净不了了。
赵明指着云杳杳，手指抖得如同风中落叶，脸色煞白，嘴唇哆嗦，那句“涮火锅”
和“烤着吃”
如同魔音灌耳，在他脑海里疯狂回荡。
“你…你…那是七霞琉璃盏！
三百年才长一叶！
有元婴师叔布下的禁制！

你…你怎么…”
赵明感觉自己的修仙生涯才刚刚开始，就要因为看管不力而提前结束了。
他甚至没想明白，那禁制是怎么被这看起来人畜无害、甚至有点缺心眼的小师妹给破掉的？难道也是自己掉下来的？！
云杳杳看着赵明快要厥过去的样子，默默地把手里那半片璀璨的叶子又往身后藏了藏，脸上努力挤出最无辜、最乖巧的表情：“师兄，你别激动…它…它可能就是长得不太结实…风一吹就…就掉渣了？对，掉渣！
要不…我帮你粘回去？”
粘回去？！
赵明眼前一黑，差点真的一头栽倒。
旁边的林风啸等人看得眼角直抽，再一次深刻认识到，这位小师妹的“不凡”
之处，绝不仅仅体现在问心阶上。
就在赵明不知该如何是好，考虑是不是要立刻上报请罪时，数道强横无匹却又收敛至极的神念瞬间扫过此地，紧接着，不远处空间微微波动，如同水纹荡漾，数道身影凭空出现。
这些人并未刻意散发威压，但仅仅是站在那里，就仿佛与周围的天地灵气融为一体，深不可测。
他们衣着气质各异，有周身隐有烈焰虚影环绕的红袍大汉，有身披水蓝轻纱、气质温婉柔美的仙子，有背负古剑、眼神锐利如电的金袍中年，有手持玉箫、飘逸出尘的青衫文士，有穿着粗布衣、气息如山岳般沉稳的壮汉，还有一位身穿繁复星纹道袍、手持罗盘的老者，以及一位笼罩在淡淡阴影中、气息若有若无的黑袍人。
正是青云宗内各主峰的峰主或代表长老！
显然，问心阶的惊天异象和测灵根的诡异结果，早已惊动了这些宗门高层。
他们此刻现身，目的不言而喻——为了云杳杳！
赵明见到来人，腿一软，差点直接跪下，连忙躬身行礼，声音发颤：“弟子…弟子赵明，参见各位峰主、长老！
是…是这位新入门的云师妹，她…她不小心碰掉了七霞琉璃盏的一片叶子…”
他实在没勇气说“摘”
甚至“尝”
几位大能的目光瞬间聚焦在云杳杳…以及她藏在身后的手上，那微弱的七彩琉璃光晕根本瞒不过他们的感知。

云杳杳感觉数道如同实质、仿佛能看透她灵魂的目光扫过自己，她眨了眨眼，慢吞吞地把那半片闪烁着七彩琉璃光晕的叶子拿了出来，小声辩解：“它自己掉的…我就捡起来看看…没想吃…”
最后三个字说得有点底气不足。
那位周身隐有烈焰虚影的红袍大汉率先开口，声如洪钟，带着灼热的气息：“哼！
一片叶子而已，碎了也就碎了！
content_en:
"That's the Qi...Qixia glazed lamp!
A treasure leaf that only takes three hundred years to grow!
It is one of the main ingredients for refining Nascent Soul Stage elixirs!
There are...there are forbidden guards!
How did you take it off? !
Want to make hot pot? !
! "
Yun Yaoyao looked at Zhao Ming's pale face and trembling fingers, blinked innocently, and quickly hid the half of the leaf behind his hands, with a look of "I didn't do anything."
expression:
"Ah? Restricted? Didn't you feel it? It fell by itself. It's a pity that I lost it... Can't it be rinsed? How about roasting it and eating it?"
Zhao Ming pointed at her, his fingers trembling and trembling, and he almost lost his breath.
He had a premonition that the inner sect of Qingyun Sect might be about to usher in an unprecedented... demon king.
Lin Fengxiao and others who were walking in front looked back and saw this scene, and once again fell into deep silence and confusion.
This little junior sister who caused eternal visions, detected waste spiritual roots, and whose first thought about rare spiritual plants was whether she could cook hot pot... In the future, this Qingyun Sect may never be clean again.
Zhao Ming pointed at Yun Yaoyao, his fingers shaking like leaves falling in the wind, his face turned pale, his lips trembled, and he said "shake hot pot"
and “roast and eat.”
It was like a demonic voice filling his ears, echoing crazily in his mind.
"You...you...that's the Qixia Glazed Lamp!
It takes three hundred years to grow one leaf!
There is a restriction imposed by Uncle Yuanying!
You...how did you..."
Zhao Ming felt that his career as an immortal had just begun and was about to end prematurely due to poor supervision.
He didn't even think about how the restriction was broken by this little junior sister who looked harmless and even a little heartless? Did he also fall off on his own? !
Yun Yaoyao looked at Zhao Ming who was about to pass away, and silently hid the half of the bright leaf behind his back. He tried his best to put on the most innocent and well-behaved expression on his face: "Senior brother, don't be excited...it...it may just not be strong enough...it will fall off when the wind blows? Yes, it will fall off!"
How about... let me glue it back on for you? "
Glue it back? !
Zhao Ming's vision went dark and he almost fell down.
Lin Fengxiao and others next to them saw it with twitching eyes, and once again realized deeply that this little junior sister was "extraordinary"
This is not only reflected in the level of asking the mind.
Just when Zhao Ming didn't know what to do and was considering whether to report the crime immediately, several powerful but extremely restrained spiritual thoughts swept over the place in an instant. Then, the space not far away fluctuated slightly, like water ripples, and several figures appeared out of thin air.
These people did not deliberately exude coercion, but just standing there seemed to be integrated with the surrounding aura of heaven and earth, which was unfathomable.
They were dressed in different styles. There were big men in red robes surrounded by looming flames, fairies in light blue gauze with a gentle and gentle temperament, middle-aged men in gold robes with ancient swords on their backs and eyes as sharp as lightning, and elegant men with jade flutes in their hands. Among the green-robed scribes in the dust were a strong man in coarse cloth with an aura as steady as a mountain, an old man wearing a Taoist robe with complex star patterns and holding a compass, and a man in black robe shrouded in light shadows with a vague aura.
They are the peak masters or representative elders of each main peak in Qingyun Sect!
Obviously, the shocking vision at the Wenxin level and the strange results of the spirit root test had already alarmed these sect senior officials.
They showed up at this moment, and their purpose was self-evident - for Yun Yaoyao!
When Zhao Ming saw the person coming, his legs went weak and he almost knelt down. He quickly bowed and saluted with a trembling voice: "Disciple... Disciple Zhao Ming, here are all the peak masters and elders!
It's...it's this new Junior Sister Yun, she...she accidentally knocked off a leaf of the Qixia Glazed Cup..."
He really didn't have the courage to say "pick"
Even "taste"
The eyes of several powerful experts were instantly focused on Yun Yaoyao... and her hand hidden behind her back. The weak colorful glaze halo could not hide from their perception at all.
Yun Yaoyao felt that the Dao was like substance, as if it could see through her soul.Scanning her eyes, she blinked, and slowly took out the half of the leaf that shimmered with colorful glaze, and she defended in a low voice: "It fell by itself... I just picked it up to take a look... I didn't want to eat it..."
The last three words are a bit lacking in confidence.
The big man in red robe with the looming shadow of flames around his body spoke first, his voice was like a bell, and his breath was scorching: "Hmph!
It’s just a leaf. If it breaks, it will break!
